english: Whistling pine, beach she-oak, horsetail tree

teaser.en: Stand under one on a windy day at Diani and you will hear why it is called the whistling pine.
teaser.sw: Simama chini yake siku yenye upepo huko Diani na utasikia kwa nini kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *whistling pine*, 'msonobari unaopiga mluzi'.
teaser.dg: Ima photsize siku ya phepho uchikala Diani, nawe undasikira sababu unaoihwa *whistling pine*.

summary.en: *Mvinde*, the whistling pine, is a fast-growing introduced tree with drooping, needle-like twigs, planted on beaches, dunes and in woodlots. It supplies poles, firewood and charcoal, and is promoted as a way to take pressure off the mangroves.
summary.sw: *Mvinde*, au mvinje, ni mti ulioletwa kutoka nje unaokua haraka, wenye vitawi vinavyoning'inia kama sindano, unaopandwa kwenye fukwe, matuta ya mchanga na mashamba ya miti. Hutoa nguzo, kuni na mkaa, na unahimizwa kama njia ya kupunguza shinikizo kwa mikoko.
summary.dg: *Mvinde* ni muhi mjeni unaokula haraka, wenye vigongo vyembamba dza sindano vinavyogbwadzika. Nkuphandwa ufuwoni, kpwenye vilima vya mtsanga na kpwenye mashamba ga mihi. Unalavya nguzo, kuni na makala, na unatogolwa dza njira ya kupunguza mzigo kpwenye mikoko.

about.en:
*Mvinde* looks like a pine but is not one. What seem to be needles are thin, jointed green twigs, drooping in soft tassels; the true leaves are tiny scales at each joint. When the wind blows through the crown, the twigs make a soft whistling or sighing sound.

The tree grows fast, tall and straight. Its small woody cones, the size of a marble, litter the ground beneath it, along with a carpet of fallen twigs.
about.sw:
*Mvinde* unafanana na msonobari lakini si msonobari. Kinachoonekana kuwa sindano ni vitawi vyembamba vya kijani vyenye vifundo, vinavyoning'inia kama vishada laini; majani halisi ni magamba madogo sana kwenye kila kifundo. Upepo unapovuma kupitia taji lake, vitawi hutoa sauti laini ya mluzi au ya kuhema.

Mti huu hukua haraka, mrefu na umenyooka. Koni zake ndogo ngumu kama mbao, za ukubwa wa gololi, hutapakaa ardhini chini yake, pamoja na zulia la vitawi vilivyoanguka.
about.dg:
*Mvinde* unaonekana dza *pine* ela si *pine*. Vira vinavyoonekana dza sindano kpwa kpweli ni vigongo vyembamba vya chijani vyenye viungo, vinavyogbwadzika dza vishada laini; makodza ga kpweli ni magamba madide sana kpwenye chila chiungo. Phepho richitsupa kahi ya dariye, vigongo vinahenda sauti ya pore ya milozi au ya mseho.

Muhi hinyu unakula haraka, mure na wa chocho. Matundage madide ga mbao, sawa na sokota, ganatawanyika photsize phamwenga na vigongo virivyogbwa vinavyofwinika photsi dza jamvi.

where.en: It is an introduced tree, planted on beaches and dunes at places such as Diani and Tiwi, and in woodlots. Its feathery, grey-green silhouette is easy to pick out along the beachfront.
where.sw: Ni mti ulioletwa kutoka nje, unaopandwa kwenye fukwe na matuta ya mchanga katika maeneo kama Diani na Tiwi, na katika mashamba ya miti. Umbo lake la rangi ya kijani-kijivu linalofanana na manyoya ni rahisi kulitambua kando ya ufuo.
where.dg: Ni muhi mjeni, unaophandwa ufuwoni na kpwenye vilima vya mtsanga phatu dza Diani na Tiwi, na kpwenye mashamba ga mihi. Suraye ya rangi ya ivu-ivu na chijani, dza nyoya, ni rahisi kuiona kanda-kanda ya ufuwo.

uses.en:
*Mvinde* gives poles for house building, firewood that burns very well, and charcoal. It has also been used for dhow masts. Planted in rows, it serves as a windbreak and holds sand dunes in place.

Because it grows fast and straight, woodlots of *mvinde* have been proposed as a source of poles and fuel to take pressure off the mangroves.
uses.sw:
*Mvinde* hutoa nguzo za kujengea nyumba, kuni zinazowaka vizuri sana, na mkaa. Pia umetumika kwa milingoti ya majahazi. Ukipandwa kwa safu, hutumika kuzuia upepo na kushikilia matuta ya mchanga yasihame.

Kwa sababu hukua haraka na kunyooka, mashamba ya *mvinde* yamependekezwa kama chanzo cha nguzo na nishati ili kupunguza shinikizo kwa mikoko.
uses.dg:
*Mvinde* unalavya nguzo za kudzengera nyumba, kuni zinazoaka vinono sana, na makala. Piya ukahumirwa kuhenda milingoti ya majahazi. Uchiphandwa kpwa mistari, unazuwiya phepho na unagbwira vilima vya mtsanga visiuke.

Kpwa sababu unakula haraka na wa chocho, mashamba ga *mvinde* gakatogolwa dza chanzo cha nguzo na kuni, ili kupunguza mzigo kpwenye mikoko.

culture.en: Its name is borrowed: Pakia lists *mvinde* among the Digo words taken from Swahili, from *mvinje*. Pakia also lists *ruwa*, an ornamental use of the tree.
culture.sw: Jina lake ni la kukopwa: Pakia anaorodhesha *mvinde* miongoni mwa maneno ya Kidigo yaliyochukuliwa kutoka Kiswahili, kutoka *mvinje*. Pakia pia anaorodhesha *ruwa*, matumizi ya mti huu kwa urembo.
culture.dg: Dzinare ni ra kukopwa: Pakia anaandika *mvinde* kahi ya maneno ga Chidigo garigohalwa kula Chiswahili, kula *mvinje*. Pakia piya anaandika *ruwa*, matumizi ga muhi hinyu ga kupamba.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mvinde*, also *mkasuarina*, from the scientific name. *Mvinde* is borrowed from the Swahili *mvinje*. In English it is the whistling pine, beach she-oak or horsetail tree, and its scientific name is *Casuarina equisetifolia*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mvinde*, pia *mkasuarina*, kutokana na jina la kisayansi. *Mvinde* limekopwa kutoka Kiswahili *mvinje*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *whistling pine*, *beach she-oak* au *horsetail tree*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Casuarina equisetifolia*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mvinde*, piya *mkasuarina*, kula dzina ra chisayansi. *Mvinde* rikahalwa kula Chiswahili *mvinje*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *whistling pine*, *beach she-oak* au *horsetail tree*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Casuarina equisetifolia*.

conservation.en: It is an introduced tree. The Vanga Blue Forest plan promotes it as an alternative source of fuel and poles to protect the mangroves.
conservation.sw: Ni mti ulioletwa kutoka nje. Mpango wa Vanga Blue Forest unauhimiza kama chanzo mbadala cha nishati na nguzo ili kulinda mikoko.
conservation.dg: Ni muhi mjeni. Mpango wa Vanga Blue Forest unautogola dza chanzo chanjina cha kuni na nguzo ili kurinda mikoko.

reason.en: Woodlots of mvinde are meant to spare the mangrove poles
reason.sw: Mashamba ya mvinde yanalenga kuokoa nguzo za mikoko
reason.dg: Mashamba ga *mvinde* ganalondwa kuzuwiya nguzo za mikoko zisikatwe

reason.sw: Mkandaa, chanzo kingine cha nguzo za nyumba
reason.dg: Chanzo chanjina cha nguzo za nyumba

reason.en: Also binds the sand of the dunes
reason.sw: Nao pia hushikilia mchanga wa matuta
reason.dg: Nao piya unagbwira mtsanga wa vilima vya ufuwoni

reason.en: Another tree planted along Diani's beaches
reason.sw: Mkungu, mti mwingine unaopandwa kando ya fukwe za Diani
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina unaophandwa kanda-kanda ya ufuwo wa Diani
